notes:
Calmer screens, and calendar access that survives updates.

- Calendar access no longer resets after an update. Donna is now signed the same way every time, so macOS keeps her permissions; you'll need to connect Calendars once more after this update, and never again after that.
- Reminders: your list comes first. Quick ideas show only while you type in an empty box, New reminder sits beside it, and search and filters appear once you have more than five reminders.
- Each reminder card is one quiet row: title, time, one tag, Done, and a ⋯ menu with Edit, Skip this one and Delete.
- Sidebar: a small Donna face beside "Next up", with just Pause. Test reminder and Preview reminder moved to Settings > Try it.
- About > Updates: when Check for updates finds a new version, Install and restart appears right there, not only at the top of the window.
